messages:
Maria: FYI we've got a customer on v1/streaming complaining that the stream ends abruptly and the final JSON chunk never arrives. They send Accept: text/event-stream and get a bunch of data but the last chunk is missing and there's no finish_reason.
Dan: Got it — can you paste the raw SSE capture from the customer? Need request_id + example payload to repro.
Maria: Pasting the sanitized capture they sent (timestamps removed):
```
event: chunk
data: {"id":"r-abc123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]}

event: chunk
data: {"id":"r-abc123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" world"}}]}

event: chunk
data: {"id":"r-abc123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"!"}}]}

# then connection closed by client, no final event with finish_reason or final JSON.
```
Maria: They say client sees a 200 then socket close, sometimes a WebSocket/HTTP2 reset (no 4xx/5xx). Billing concern: customer says tokens were charged but output incomplete.
Priya: Thanks — do we have any deploys around that timestamp? Could be an internal keepalive/idle timeout.
deploy-bot: Deploy rtx-2026-03-12 rolled to runtime-nodes in us-west-2 at 2026-03-12T14:22:00Z (linked: #4567).
Leo: Seeing a number of connection resets (1006) in LB logs yesterday around 14:21-14:25 UTC. ALB idle timeout is default 60s for streaming; if client reconnect logic closes earlier, we might get truncated streams.
Ashley: Is this reproducing only on longer responses or even short ones?
Maria: Customer reported both — majority were longer but we've seen short messages (~2-3 tokens) also sometimes truncated.
Dan: Can you share request headers + curl repro so we can try locally? Also need the request_id if present.
Maria: Repro curl they used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"say hi and then pause","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
Maria: request_id they sent: r-abc123 (same as capture).
Priya: Engineering notes: streaming uses continuous chunked transfer; we rely on client to keep connection open until final event. If connection resets/gateway interrupts before finalization, we can end up with partial JSON. We should: (1) detect streams closed without final event and mark as 'truncated' in logs, (2) include a short finalization heartbeat event that is unlikely to be lost, and (3) improve client SDK reconnect semantics to attempt finishing retrieval.
Leo: Also check proxy/nginx keepalive settings between runtime and ALB — we've had one case where idle proxy dropped connection after ~55s. Suggest increasing keepalive and adding per-request last-byte timeout logs.
Dan: Customer also asked about billing — do we charge for partial outputs?
Priya: Billing team: tokens are billed per-token generated by runtime. If the model generated the final tokens but they weren't delivered due to network issues, billing still reflects generation. We can offer a one-time credit while we investigate.
Ashley: For the short-term support response, suggest: repro steps for them (curl with --no-buffer), ask them to include X-Request-ID header, and collect ALB logs + client-side socket logs (WS close code). Offer a credit and explain we're preventing future occurrences with a follow-up rollout.
Dan: Repro steps to send to customer (concise):
1) Re-run with --no-buffer to avoid client-side buffering: `curl -N --no-buffer ...`
2) Include `X-Request-ID: <uuid>` in the request so we can match logs
3) If using a browser SSE client, capture Network tab + console, note any socket close events and close codes
4) If possible, try from a different network (mobile/ISP) to rule out intermediate proxies

Dan: Also opening an internal bug with priority P1 because it's customer-impacting and has billing concerns. Assigning to Priya + Leo.
Priya: Action items for infra/engineers:
- Add detection for stream sessions that terminate without finalization event (logs + metric)
- Consider emitting an explicit `event: done` or `event: final` containing the final JSON and a CRC/sequence number as a lightweight finalizer
- Improve SDKs to attempt client-side resume where feasible and surface partial-response flags to caller
- Add automated check in the runtime that, when a connection terminates with no finish token, writes a `truncated=true` entry to audit log so billing/support can reconcile

Leo: I'll check ALB/proxy timeouts and roll a small change to extend idle timeout to 120s in canary to see if incidence drops.
Maria: I'll reply to the customer with the repro checklist, ask for X-Request-ID and logs, and offer a credit while we dig in.
Dan: Thanks — please paste any captures here and update thread. :thumbsup:
Maria: uploaded a follow-up capture from the customer showing an incomplete JSON snippet on their side: `{\"id\":\"r-abc123\",\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"This is partial\"}}` (no closing braces).
Priya: That exact symptom matches abrupt TCP close. We'll correlate with LB logs for r-abc123 and get back in 4 hours with findings.
Leo: Adding note: if we see HTTP/2 RST_STREAM with code 2 or 11 in the proxy, that will indicate client or proxy abort. I'll filter logs for those codes.
Maria: marking thread for follow-up and escalation path if we confirm infra root cause.
